normative.review: The BindingConnector requires equal related values, base selfLinks specialization and binary arity. These binding-specific clauses prescribe no static rejection simply because the two endpoint type names differ. Equality/satisfiability and the other inherited constraints remain distinct obligations; this review does not assert the complete model is semantically verified.

observed_diagnostic.message: Bound features should have conforming types

pilot.behavior: The pinned binding conformance helper warns on failed symmetric type conformance, with a separate Boolean-expression exception. Warning severity permits model transformation/export. No value coercion was observed or prescribed.

native_contract.terminal_expectation: Retain the frozen accepted boundary; differing endpoint names alone must not become a new error or unsupported negative expectation.
native_contract.storage: Preserve the Boolean result declaration, integer literal, actual inherited integer result and required binding. Do not coerce a value or replace either type to match Pilot.
native_contract.diagnostic: Implement and independently verify any applicable conformance diagnostic through the shared native type/prototype and expression algorithms. The diagnostic algorithm is currently unverified.
remaining: Actual input/provider lifecycle, inherited validation constraints, canonical publication and persistence.
Native symmetric type conformance and Boolean-expression semantic dependencies used by the reference diagnostic.
Full model satisfiability/equality must not be claimed from static warning behavior.
